judgments.reason: The vignette explicitly states 'Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes,' which directly supports CMV drug resistance as these are well-known resistance mutations in CMV antiviral targets.

The serial CMV viral load measurements show a rising trend over time (from 63 IU/mL up to 3171 IU/mL during admission), which clinically supports persistent/refractory infection consistent with drug resistance, making this span a reasonable support for the drug resistance modifier.
